name: Miramichi
text: Miramichi is the largest city in northern New Brunswick, Canada. It is situated at the mouth of the Miramichi River where it enters Miramichi Bay. The Miramichi Valley is the second longest valley in New Brunswick, after the Saint John River Valley.

depictions.name: Miramichi
depictions.text: Miramichi, New Brunswick Miramichi is the largest city in northern New Brunswick, Canada. In the 18th century, Miramichi was a largely uninhabited region, featuring rapidly sloping mountaineous terrain and a cold climate. Still, the area possessed a few residents that had set up houses near the coast, while a hunting cabin lay slightly further inland.
